list.text: Cianwood City Pharmacy
500 Years of Tradition\nWe Await Your Medicinal Queries
Estamos esperando suas encomendas.
Cianwood City Pokémon Gym Leader: Chuck\nHis Roaring Fists Do the Talking
You crossed the sea to get here?
That must have been hard.
If you beat the Gym Leader here, come see me.\nI'll have a nice gift for you.
That's Cianwood's Gym Badge!
Then you should take this TM.
Teach Surf to your Pokémon.
The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
My husband lost to you, so he needs to train harder.
That's good, since he was getting a little chubby.
There are several islands between here and Olivine.
A mythical sea creature supposedly lives there.
Boulders to the north of town can be crushed.
They may be hiding something.\nYour Pokémon could use Rock Smash to break them.
If you use Fly, you can get back to Olivine instantly.
Cianwood City\nA Port of Crashing Waves.
\f[faceEusine]\bYo, \PN.
\f[faceEusine]\bWasn't that SUICUNE just now?
\f[faceEusine]\bI only caught a quick glimpse, but I thought I saw SUICUNE running on the waves.
\f[faceEusine]\bSUICUNE is beaultiful and grand. \nAnd it races through towns and roads at simply awesome speeds.
\f[faceEusine]\bIt's wonderful...
\f[faceEusine]\bI want to see SUICUNE up close...
\f[faceEusine]\bI've decided.\nI'll battle you as Trainer to earn SUICUNE's respect!
\f[faceEusine]\bCome on \PN.\nLet's battle now!

lines: EndSpeech: Eu odeio admitir, mas você venceu.

then.text: \f[faceEusine]\bI'm starting to understand why SUICUNE was keeping an eye on you.
\f[faceEusine]\bI'm going to keep searching for SUICUNE.
\f[faceEusine]\bI have a feeling we'll see each other again. See you around!

list.text: This is the house of Cameron, the Photographer. \nTake a Snapshot as Keepsake!
Politoed: Po-li-toed!
There is an automatic camera.
Do you want to take a picture?

branches.text: It will proceed to take a picture.

lines: This event can happenin Mahogany, Olivine or Cianwood - it happens right after the player gets the 7th badge.
